d: The Dangote refinery mega initial public offering is expected to break all African funding records. The IPO was extended by two weeks, even though reports say that its entire funding target was already achieved through just Nigerian and retail investors. Africa's richest man, Aliko Dangote, billed the share sale as "the People's IPO", and was allowing people to buy as little as 10 shares, for only $4.
